name: Living room
fixed: Stacked stone fireplace with timber mantel
description: Living room in a 1960s cabin. Floor-to-ceiling stacked stone fireplace with a rough timber mantel, flanked by two tall windows looking at trees. TV is mounted on the wall right of the chimney, partly in front of a window. Brown leather club chair left, old steamer trunk right. Sofa faces the fireplace. Small red rug.
